subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add a configurable non-USD currency contract for local model-cost estimates, and should it be provider-scoped, model-scoped, global, or display-only?
rationale: The request adds public config and changes accounting/display semantics across status output, Control UI usage analysis, docs, and USD-named fields, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Choose scope, validation, aggregation behavior, field naming, docs, and migration expectations before implementation.

options.title: Keep local estimates USD-only
options.body: Document configured model costs as USD per million tokens and leave non-USD values only in provider-reported billing surfaces.

options.title: Allow display-only override
options.body: Permit a narrow symbol or ISO display override while explicitly preserving USD-shaped storage and aggregate semantics.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose scope, validation, aggregation behavior, field naming, docs, and migration expectations before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent usage-cost and provider-billing merges are the closest current ownership trail for this product/data-contract decision.
